name: gizza-ai/drum-pattern-generator
summary: Generate deterministic drum grooves as MIDI, WAV preview audio and an ASCII step grid

tool.description: Generate a deterministic drum pattern from genre, time signature, bar count, tempo, complexity, subdivision, swing, humanize, fill, velocity, kit and seed controls. The tool emits General MIDI drum data on channel 10, a pure-Rust rendered WAV preview when enabled, and an ASCII step grid for text surfaces. The same parameters always produce byte-identical MIDI and WAV output.

bars.description: Number of bars to generate, from 1 to 64. MIDI always covers every bar; long WAV previews are truncated to a safe length.

complexity.description: Pattern density: basic drops embellishments, standard gives a usable groove, and busy adds extra kicks, ghosts or percussion where the genre supports it.

fill_every.description: Add a tom/snare fill on every Nth bar. Use 0 for no fills; values above the bar count simply produce no fill.

genre.description: Genre preset for the groove. Each preset picks a typical tempo, its core voices and its feel — for example rock, funk, house, trap, dnb, boom-bap, reggaeton, bossa-nova, jazz-swing, blues-shuffle, metal, country or waltz.

hat_subdivision.description: Grid used for hats and the ASCII preview. Auto follows the genre/complexity, or force quarter, eighth, sixteenth or triplet-eighth.

humanize.description: Deterministic timing and velocity variation, 0 to 100 percent. The seed controls the pseudo-random offsets so repeated runs are byte-identical.

kit.description: General MIDI drum kit program: standard, room, power, electronic, tr808, jazz, brush or orchestra. The kit selects the GM program number; notes stay on channel 10 percussion.

output.description: Returned shape: full report with grid, grid only, MIDI base64, WAV base64, or JSON containing summary fields and both base64 artifacts.

preview.description: Rendered audio preview mode: drums only, drums plus metronome click, click only, or off. WAV previews are capped near 30 seconds.

seed.description: Reproducible variation seed for humanize and audio noise. The same seed and parameters produce byte-identical MIDI and WAV output.

swing.description: Swing amount in percent, 0 to 75. Off-beat grid hits are delayed deterministically; triplet-eighth grooves keep their natural shuffle.

tempo.description: Tempo in BPM. Use 0 to take the genre's typical tempo, or choose an explicit tempo from 20 to 300 BPM.

time_signature.description: Meter for each bar. Supports common straight and compound signatures: 4/4, 3/4, 2/4, 5/4, 6/8, 7/8 and 12/8.

velocity.description: Base MIDI velocity from 1 to 127. Accents and ghost notes are scaled around this value and clamped to the MIDI range.
